test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 27 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank.**

The western side of the country has some ___________ (vacant) islands to explore.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'uninhabited'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 
• Vacant- a place not being lived in or used, or a job available for someone to do. (ऐसा स्थान जिसमें रहना या उपयोग न किया जा रहा हो, या कोई काम जो किसी के करने के लिए उपलब्ध हो।)
 
 
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the correct answer:
 
 
• **​Uninhabited-** a place where no people live in it. (वह स्थान जहाँ कोई मनुष्य न रहता हो।)
 
 
 
• Clearly, the word 'uninhabited' is closest in meaning to the given word 'vacant'.
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is 'uninhabited'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's know the meaning of other **options: **

 
 
• **​****Unexplored:** An unexplored place is one where people have not been to find out what is there. (एक अज्ञात स्थान वह है जहां लोग यह पता लगाने के लिए नहीं गए हैं कि वहां क्या है।)
 
• **Undesired**: Especially an action or consequence that is not wanted or desired. (विशेष रूप से एक क्रिया या परिणाम जो वांछित या वांछित नहीं है।)
 
• **Uninterested**: not excited or not wanting to become involved. (उत्साहित नहीं हैं या शामिल नहीं होना चाहते हैं।)
